en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a broad square or street bordered by multi‑storey buildings on the right and a fortified complex with round towers on the left. Mountains rise in the background under a pastel evening or morning sky. There are a few pedestrians and horse‑drawn carts in the open space, plus tall slender trees and a small red kiosk near the center-right. The word "Trento" is printed in red at the top left, with a handwritten repetition above it.
